remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Not recorded Whitney Archive. Downtown Gallery Archive and Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Also has 1924 date on it. This is An Anderson 1923 photo #4. 4/51." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "O'Keeffe dates it 1919. Betty Pilkington 1957." Stretcher inscription 3 dates 1921 and indicates no. 34 in 1923 New York (Anderson). Downtown Gallery Archive dates c. 1920 and 1924. Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1919. Dated 1921 on basis of stretcher inscriptions 1, 3. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 15. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Black, yellow, and red lines form a V-shape that intersects at the bottom of the canvas. Between these lines, two billowing, gray and black shapes that resemble draped fabric fill the abstract composition. A hint of dark blue and a circular gray shape are visible in the lower right corner of the work.
title: Abstraction
